premises.text: Car owners often face inconvenience and uncertainty when dealing with car repairs.
premises.evidence_span: don't waste your time going to a shop, begging friends for a ride, and then hoping and maybe praying that you don't get ripped off.

premises.text: Customers can receive transparent pricing and service options online.
premises.evidence_span: you can see our price. You can compare it with dealer and shop price.

premises.text: Mechanics can provide services at the customer's location.
premises.evidence_span: this awesome mechanic, Mike, will fix your car at your home, your office, or wherever you are.

premises.text: A mobile app allows mechanics to provide estimates and service details on-site.
premises.evidence_span: Mike uses our mobile app, which we can show you today. He will enter the services you need, like alternator, random example.

premises.text: The business model is based on fixed pricing with no hidden fees.
premises.evidence_span: this price that you see here is fixed by us. Always.

premises.text: The market for car repairs is large and growing, particularly for older vehicles.
premises.evidence_span: There are 200 million cars on road that are older than five years. People spend over $800 every single year fixing their cars at local garages.

premises.text: The peer-to-peer marketplace model can disrupt traditional car repair services.
premises.evidence_span: But Airbnb has shown that when you have three things, a large market, a clear pain point with a solution that resonates with everyday people on both sides of the platform, you can build a billion dollar company.

value.text: Car repair services become more accessible and transparent for consumers.
value.evidence_span: you can take care of your car problems in less than 60 seconds.

notes: No separate premises for traction or investor interest.
